title: Main board - component side - raptox's unit, stitched microscope mosaic (2026-11-03)
source: Own photos, raptox's unit: 335 microscope tiles stitched on 2026-11-03 (~229 px/mm), downscaled to ~21.6 px/mm; markings read at full resolution

callouts.label: TI CC3220S Wi-Fi MCU
callouts.part: CC3220SM2ARGK, VQFN-64 9 x 9 mm; no internal flash, boots from U15/U16
callouts.note: Body measures 9.02 mm on the mosaic; its 0.5 mm pad pitch is one of the scale references.

callouts.label: XMC XM25QH64A SPI NOR flash, 64 Mbit (8 MiB)
callouts.note: Both refdes printed at one footprint (alternate parts). PRIMARY DUMP TARGET. Pin 4 = GND, pin 8 = VCC: the continuity references.

callouts.label: TI CC2640R2F Bluetooth LE MCU
callouts.note: Pin-1 dot bottom right in this orientation.

callouts.label: QFN-40 IC 'T3018' - unidentified
callouts.note: Marking confirmed; function unknown (LED/touch driver candidate).

callouts.label: QFN-20 IC '4637' next to the speaker connector
callouts.part: QFN-20, about 3 x 3 mm, 0.4 mm pitch
callouts.note: Second line now legible: 838A or B38A, not 638A. Next to J9 and TP21-TP27: audio driver candidate (guess).

callouts.label: onsemi NCP59800 LDO: the 3.3 V regulator
callouts.part: NCP59800 (adjustable, 'ADJB'), 1 A low-noise LDO, DFN8 3 x 3 mm
callouts.note: Marking matches the datasheet's marking diagram (onsemi NCP59800/D rev. 2). Pins 7-8 IN with C577 and vias, 1-2 OUT with C579, 6 NR with C604, 3 FB with divider R589/R590. Input 2.2-6.0 V (abs. max 6.5 V), so J8 brings about 5 V. See docs/hardware/nets.md#supply.

callouts.label: SOT-23 (3 leads) 'CG4'
callouts.marking: CG4 (a faint character may precede it)
callouts.note: Was read as SOT-23-5: the mosaic shows 3 leads. With C586 and C4: LDO or supervisor (guess).

callouts.label: 3-hole header footprint - UNPOPULATED
callouts.note: Pitch 2.54 mm (measured 2.53-2.54). '3' printed at the top hole, a dot beside the bottom hole (pin 1).

callouts.label: 4-way DIP switch footprint - UNPOPULATED
callouts.note: Silkscreen 'DIP', pins 1 and 4 on the left column, 5 and 8 on the right, an 'ON' marking printed upside down.

callouts.label: Tag-Connect footprint (6 pads + 3 holes)
callouts.note: Pin numbers 1, 2, 5, 6 printed at the corners. TP16 and TP18 nearby.

callouts.label: Test points beside the CC2640R2F
callouts.note: cJTAG / reset candidates for U7.

callouts.label: Test points around U13
callouts.note: Refdes legible on the mosaic. Function unknown.

callouts.label: Test points under exposed copper pad
30-pin FPC to the power board
callouts.part: 0.5 mm pitch FPC connector, flip actuator
callouts.note: '30' printed at the top end, a circle at the bottom end next to pin 1 (pin 1 = bottom, likely). Pin span measures 14.55 mm. Pins 1-6 share one pour with C588 and C7, C7's other pad on ground: the supply, about 5 V (likely, J-076). Pins 1-6 ring through to JP5 pin 1 (continuity, J-077). Pinout: docs/hardware/j8.md.

callouts.label: Speaker connector (2-pin)
callouts.note: Pin-1 dot at the left.

callouts.label: 2-hole footprint, 2.54 mm, UNPOPULATED
callouts.note: Pin 1 square (bottom), pin 2 round with thermal spokes. The board's power header, by continuity (J-077, J-080): pin 1 = J8 pins 1-6 = U17's input (about 5 V expected), pin 2 = GND (U15 pin 4). Not fitted.

callouts.label: 5-pad SOT-23-5 footprint - UNPOPULATED
callouts.note: No part fitted (tinned pads only). C9, C19 and R578 next to it are empty too; R588 is fitted.

callouts.label: Test points around J8
callouts.note: Refdes legible: TP1 left of JP5, TP2/TP8 above U6, TP3 above J8, TP9 below J8, TP49 further up.

callouts.label: 2-pad crystal below R573 (32.768 kHz?)
callouts.note: Same marking style as Y1. Its refdes is not printed next to it; 'Y4' sits further right. CC3220 RTC crystal (guess).

callouts.label: 2-pad crystal beside U7 (32.768 kHz?)
callouts.note: CC2640R2F 32 kHz crystal (guess).

callouts.label: 6-pad ceramic part beside U7 (balun/filter)
callouts.note: Pin-3 dot printed.

callouts.label: Antenna zones (yellow, copper-free)
callouts.note: The bottom zone runs past the mosaic's coverage.

callouts.label: Exposed copper pads (spring contacts on FCC sample)
Fiducials (1 mm copper dot in a mask-free disc)
callouts.note: No holes. FID1 is the origin of the mechanics table in main-board.md.

callouts.label: Heat-stake posts (board riveted to the bezel)
callouts.part: melted white plastic, tops about 2.9 mm
callouts.note: Positions in the mechanics table, main-board.md.

callouts.label: Locating pins in plated holes
callouts.note: Flat tops in gold-ringed plated holes: alignment pins (guess).

callouts.label: Discrete circuit (Q3, C605-C607, R591-R594, R559, TP50)
Production label '004D2 / 90718PM' (Data Matrix greyed out)
callouts.note: The Data Matrix is decodable at full resolution and is greyed out in every published image until its content is known.

callouts.label: Bare round test pads, no refdes printed (P1-P9 are our names, top to bottom)
callouts.note: Two groups: P1-P4 above, P5-P9 below. Mask-free round pads, about 0.9 mm. P5-P8 sit on the flash side of the four series resistors on the CC3220 flash bus (CLK, DOUT, DIN, CS); P1-P4 and P9 are not followed yet. See docs/hardware/nets.md.

callouts.label: Flash bus series resistors (4x 0402, no refdes printed nearby)
callouts.note: Top to bottom in series with CC3220 pins 11-14 (FLASH_SPI_CLK, DOUT, DIN, CS; SWAS035C table 7-1), traced on the top layer. Values unknown (unmarked).

callouts.label: J8 supply decoupling (pins 1-6 pour)
callouts.note: Their J8-side pads sit on the pour of J8 pins 1-6, with JP5 pin 1. C7's other pad is on the via-stitched ground pour around J8; C588's other pad is not resolved on the photo. See docs/hardware/nets.md#supply.
